items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said, “John Neves.” I said, “Who’s playing bass?” ... So we went down front. It was time to rehearse... I knew that I was with a great drummer

ctx.x: I had this gig at Connolly’s. I had it because of my condition. Again, I had a hard time getting out of New York. I had to run around and try to gather up some money and get myself set to leave town. I didn’t want to go out of town and not be prepared to take care of myself up in Boston. I didn’t know anybody. I had to – yeah, this is The Connection. Some wild stuff. That thing went on for years. That’s a great album. One of my favorite albums. So I went up and did – when I got to the club, Tony was standing…
You brought him back to New York?
